7.00002M17 7L7 17" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="square"></path></svg></a></div></div></span><p>Provide reference images, a preset voice, or both to guide the generated video. Images incorporate specific people, objects, clothing, or other visual elements without locking the first frame (unlike <a href="/developers/model-capabilities/video/image-to-video" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">image-to-video</a>). This is useful for virtual try-on, product placement, and stories with recurring characters. On <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">grok-imagine-video-1.5</code></span>, you can also pick the voice your subject speaks in (see <a href="#reference-audio" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">Reference audio</a>), pin the exact first or last frame (see <a href="#first--last-frame" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">First &amp; Last frame</a>), and pin frames at chosen moments inside the clip (see <a href="#keyframes" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">Keyframes</a>).</p><p>Each reference image can be provided as a public HTTPS URL, a base64-encoded data URI, or a <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">file_id</code></span> from the <a href="/developers/files" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">Files API</a> — and you can mix kinds within a single request. See <a href="/developers/model-capabilities/imagine/files/inputs" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">Imagine → Files API Integration</a> for <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">file_id</code></span> details and examples.</p><p>In the Vercel AI SDK, set <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">providerOptions.xai.mode</code></span> to <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">&quot;reference-to-video&quot;</code></span> and pass the images with <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">providerOptions.xai.referenceImageUrls</code></span>.</p><p>Prompts are capped at 4,096 bytes. With many references, give each one a single role and a fixed place in the scene, keep the cast small, and keep props static.</p></div><div data-wide-section="true" class="mx-auto w-full max-w-4xl Identifiers are case-insensitive; an unknown one returns <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">400</code></span> with the list of available voices. You can hear every voice in the <a href="https://x.ai/news/new-flagship-voices" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">flagship voices announcement</a>.</p><p><span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">reference_audios</code></span> accepts preset voices; voice references with your own audio files are available to trusted partners <a href="https://x.ai/contact-sales?interest=imagine" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">on request</a>. The video ends arriving on that image rather than re-rendering it as a reference. <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">image</code></span> combined with <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">reference_images</code></span>, <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">reference_audios</code></span>, or <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">last_frame</code></span> is the matching first-frame pin.</p><div class="not-prose my-6 w-full overflow-x-auto"><table class="w-full border-collapse text-left text-sm [&amp;_thead_tr]:border-border [&amp;_thead_tr]:border-b [&amp;_th]:text-secondary [&amp;_th]:px-3 [&amp;_th]:py-2.5 [&amp;_th]:text-left [&amp;_th]:align-bottom [&amp;_th]:text-sm [&amp;_th]:font-light [&amp;_tbody]:divide-border [&amp;_tbody]:divide-y [&amp;_td]:px-3 [&amp;_td]:py-4 [&amp;_td]:align-top [&amp;_td:first-child]:text-primary [&amp;_td:first-child]:font-medium [&amp;_td:first-child]:!pl-0 [&amp;_th:first-child]:!pl-0 [&amp;_td_li]:before:text-subtle [&amp;_td_li]:before:mr-1.5 [&amp;_td_li]:before:content-[&quot;•&quot;] [&amp;_td_ul]:m-0 [&amp;_td_ul]:list-none [&amp;_td_ul]:space-y-1.5 [&amp;_td_ul]:p-0 [&amp;_tbody_tr:last-child_td]:border-b-0"><thead><tr><th>Request shape</th><th>Result</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">image</code></span> + <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">last_frame</code></span></td><td>Pinned first and last frame. Add <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">image</code></span> to pin the first frame as well.</td></tr></tbody></table></div><p><span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">prompt</code></span> is optional in every first &amp; last frame request. Include one to steer motion and camera work between the frames; omit it to let the frames alone drive the clip.</p><p><span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">last_frame</code></span> uses the same URL, data-URI, and <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">file_id</code></span> shapes as <a href="/developers/model-capabilities/video/image-to-video" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">image-to-video</a>. In the xAI Python SDK, pass <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">last_frame_url</code></span> (or <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">last_frame_file_id</code></span> for a Files API upload) alongside <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">image_url</code></span> (or <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">image_file_id</code></span>). The Vercel AI SDK does not expose <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">last_frame</code></span> yet; send it on the REST body.</p><span class="not-prose"><div <span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  {</span><span style="color:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">"image"</span><span style="color:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">: {</span><span style="color:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">"url"</span><span style="color:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">: </span><span style="color:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">"&#x3C;KEYFRAME_URL_1>"</span><span style="color:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">}, </span><span style="color:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">"timestamp_s"</span><span style="color:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">: </span><span style="color:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">2.0</span><span style="color:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">},</span></span>

<span class="line"></span></code></pre></div></div></div></span><p>Keyframes cover the interior of the clip; the endpoints keep their own fields. Pin the opening with <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">image</code></span> and the closing with <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">last_frame</code></span>, and combine any of the three with <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">reference_images</code></span> or <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">reference_audios</code></span>. <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">prompt</code></span> is optional whenever a frame is pinned.</p><div class="not-prose my-6 w-full overflow-x-auto"><table class="w-full border-collapse text-left text-sm [&amp;_thead_tr]:border-border [&amp;_thead_tr]:border-b [&amp;_th]:text-secondary [&amp;_th]:px-3 [&amp;_th]:py-2.5 [&amp;_th]:text-left [&amp;_th]:align-bottom [&amp;_th]:text-sm [&amp;_th]:font-light [&amp;_tbody]:divide-border [&amp;_tbody]:divide-y [&amp;_td]:px-3 [&amp;_td]:py-4 [&amp;_td]:align-top [&amp;_td:first-child]:text-primary [&amp;_td:first-child]:font-medium [&amp;_td:first-child]:!pl-0 [&amp;_th:first-child]:!pl-0 [&amp;_td_li]:before:text-subtle [&amp;_td_li]:before:mr-1.5 [&amp;_td_li]:before:content-[&quot;•&quot;] [&amp;_td_ul]:m-0 [&amp;_td_ul]:list-none [&amp;_td_ul]:space-y-1.5 [&amp;_td_ul]:p-0 [&amp;_tbody_tr:last-child_td]:border-b-0"><thead><tr><th>Constraint</th><th>Detail</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>Count</td><td>At most 4 keyframes per request.</td></tr><tr><td>Timing</td><td><span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">timestamp_s</code></span> must fall strictly inside the clip: greater than 0 and less than <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">duration</code></span>.</td></tr><tr><td>Spacing</td><td>Anchors snap to a 1/3-second grid. Two keyframes that round to the same slot are rejected, so keep them at least 1/3 s apart.</td></tr><tr><td>Inputs</td><td>Each <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">image</code></span> accepts the same URL, data-URI, and <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">file_id</code></span> shapes as <a href="/developers/model-capabilities/video/image-to-video" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">image-to-video</a>.</td></tr></tbody></table></div><p>In the xAI Python SDK, <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">keyframes</code></span> is a list of dicts that flatten the REST <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">image</code></span> object: each entry takes <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">image_url</code></span> (or <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">image_file_id</code></span>) and <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">timestamp</code></span>, the REST <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">timestamp_s</code></span> in seconds, as in <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">{&quot;image_url&quot;: &quot;&lt;KEYFRAME_URL_1&gt;&quot;, &quot;timestamp&quot;: 2.0}</code></span>. Pin the endpoints with <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">image_url</code></span> and <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">last_frame_url</code></span>. The Vercel AI SDK does not expose <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">keyframes</code></span> yet; send it on the REST body.</p><span class="not-prose"><h3 id="example-a-year-that-loops" class="scroll-mt-28 transition-colors duration-100 ease-in-out lg:scroll-mt-24 text-primary font-display text-xl leading-snug tracking-tight sm:text-2xl mb-3 mt-10"><a class="not-prose" href="#example-a-year-that-loops">Example: a year that loops</a></h3></span><p>Pins work best when they share a scene: generate one still, then make the others with <a href="/developers/model-capabilities/images/editing" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">image editing</a> so only what should change differs. To loop a clip, pass the same image as <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">image</code></span> and <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">last_frame</code></span>.</p><figure class="not-prose my-6 flex flex-col gap-4"><div class="relative cursor-pointer select-none overflow-hidden rounded-xl bg-neutral-900"><div class="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center bg-neutral-900"><div class="flex flex-col items-center gap-3"><div class="size-6 animate-spin rounded-full border-2 border-white/20 border-t-white"></div><span class="text-sm text-white/60">Loading video…</span></div></div><video class="relative aspect-video w-full object-cover" muted="" loop="" playsInline="" preload="metadata"><source src="https://media.x.ai/v1/docs/oak-seasons-loop-spring-f3694aea.mp4" type="video/mp4"/></video><img alt="Spring: the frame pinned at 0 seconds" class="!max-h-none !max-w-none absolute inset-0 size-full transition-opacity duration-150 opacity-100" draggable="false" loading="lazy" decoding="async" sizes="(min-width: 1280px) 1280px, 100vw" style="object-fit:cover;background-image:url(data:image/svg+xml;base64,);background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;max-width:1280px;max-height:720px;aspect-ratio:1.7777777777777777;width:100%" srcSet="https://media.x.ai/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,onerror=redirect,width=640,height=360,f=auto/v1/docs/r2v-oak-spring-still-4b57ea6e.webp 640w,
